name: Four Seasons Hotel Madrid
insider_take: Madrid's most iconic address just got its crown jewel — the Four Seasons occupies a magnificently restored 1920s landmark building right in the heart of the city's legendary financial and cultural core.
whats_special: The Four Seasons Hotel Madrid is housed within the beautifully restored Canalejas Complex , a collection of seven historic buildings dating back to 1902. Sitting steps from the Puerta del Sol and the elegant Gran Vía , this property blends Belle Époque grandeur with contemporary luxury. Its stunning rooftop terrace, Dani Brasserie — led by Michelin-starred chef Dani García — and a world-class spa make it the undisputed pinnacle of Madrid hospitality.
pro_tip: Reserve a table at Dani Brasserie on the rooftop for sunset — the panoramic views over Madrid's skyline with the Retiro Park in the distance are absolutely breathtaking. Book well in advance as tables fill up fast!
dont_miss: Explore the Museo del Prado and Museo Reina Sofía , both a short ride away, or stroll through the historic Barrio de las Letras literary quarter. Back at the hotel, the spa and indoor pool offer a serene retreat after a day of Madrid's vibrant sights.
pros: Prime location in Madrid's prestigious Canalejas district with easy access to major attractions
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with innovative treatments
Outstanding culinary experiences with renowned restaurants and bars
Impeccable Four Seasons service standards and attention to detail
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Located in busy central district with urban environment
